questions.q: What is the formula of iron(III) sulfate?
questions.why: Fe³⁺ and SO₄²⁻: two Fe³⁺ (+6) balance three SO₄²⁻ (−6), with brackets round the compound ion.

questions.q: C₃H₈ + xO₂ → 3CO₂ + 4H₂O. What is x when the equation is balanced?
questions.why: Right side has 3 × 2 + 4 × 1 = 10 O atoms, so 5 O₂ molecules are needed.

questions.q: Which is the ionic equation for the reaction of aqueous silver nitrate with aqueous sodium chloride?
questions.why: Na⁺ and NO₃⁻ are spectator ions; silver chloride is a precipitate, so (s).

questions.q: Lithium reacts with water to form an alkaline solution of lithium hydroxide and hydrogen gas. Write the balanced symbol equation, including state symbols.
points: correct formulae Li, H₂O, LiOH, H₂
